questions.question: John the Baptist preached in the wilderness that the kingdom of heaven was near. What did he tell people to do?
John the Baptist baptized with water and said someone more powerful was coming after him. What would that person baptize with?
When Jesus came to the Jordan to be baptized, John tried to stop Him. What did John say?

answers.text: I need to be baptized by You
You must go back to Galilee

questions.question: After Jesus was baptized in the Jordan River, what did the voice from heaven say?

answers.text: This is My beloved Son in whom I am well pleased
This is My chosen servant who will rule the nations
This is the prophet who will lead My people home
